scope: Layout and non-result reproduction prose only
changes: Keep the introductory HAC sentences with their bandwidth display; remove lone H, continuation at page start.
Condense repeated availability/replay/resource prose while retaining every rights/vintage/input/independence/prospective-binding/failure constraint and all exact links.
before_reproduction_prose:
\paragraph{What is public.}
The repository provides editable sources, public aggregate results, original
design records, computational code and numerical verification evidence. Old
favourable and adverse outputs remain unchanged. The compact supplement links
the longer retained material instead of removing its rows. Exact source-field
bindings for every aggregate printed here accompany the document generator.

\paragraph{What public checking proves.}
The read-only conditional-archive entry point verifies the existing aggregate
inventory without raw observations. Document regeneration reads public
aggregates and formats their saved values. These checks establish internal
artifact consistency, not recomputed forecasting accuracy, a new sample,
independent scientific replication or journal acceptance.

\paragraph{Full financial replay requires compatible inputs.}
The original FX member and Treasury snapshot must match their recorded
fingerprints and source definitions before a separately authorized fresh
replay. Private per-origin forecasts, fitted traces and restricted FX
observations are not redistributed. Downloaded-vintage economic dates differ
from verified historical first-release availability. A current file with the
same series name is not automatically the accepted snapshot.

\paragraph{Version-specific entry points.}
The v7 merge preserves both source lines. The supervisor panel scripts retain
their original canonical paths and whole-file identity gates. Earlier panel
implementations remain as the explicitly named legacy scripts, with the same
original bytes. Historical execution contracts keep their original values and
dates; exact old-protocol replay should use its recorded source commit.
The existing prospective parameter binding is not silently reactivated or
rebound by this manuscript edit.

\paragraph{Resources and software.}
Document assembly reads existing local software and the recorded results.
The additional frozen studies were executed separately; no package installation,
model fit, data acquisition, simulation rerun or parameter search belongs to
this formatting step. The historical execution receipts report their
actual worker time, resident memory and observed threads separately from
requested budgets. Test execution uses an isolated copy of tracked inputs so
synthetic fixture writes do not alter the scientific archives.
after_reproduction_prose:
\paragraph{What is public.}
Editable sources, aggregate results, original designs, code and verification
records accompany the paper. Favourable, adverse and failed outputs remain
unchanged, with longer tables linked rather than removed. Source-field
bindings identify every printed aggregate.

\paragraph{What public checking proves.}
Archive checking and document regeneration verify saved aggregates without raw
observations. They establish artifact consistency, not recomputed forecast
accuracy, a new sample, independent replication or journal acceptance.

\paragraph{Full financial replay requires compatible inputs.}
A separately authorized replay requires the original FX member and Treasury
snapshot to match their recorded fingerprints and definitions. Restricted FX
observations and private per-origin forecasts or fitted traces are not
redistributed. Downloaded economic dates are not verified first-release
availability; a matching series name does not establish snapshot identity.

\paragraph{Version-specific entry points.}
The v7 merge preserves canonical supervisor scripts and explicitly named legacy
implementations with their original paths and whole-file identity gates.
Historical contracts retain their original parameters and dates; exact replay
requires the recorded source commit. This edit does not reactivate or reassign
the existing prospective parameter binding.

\paragraph{Resources and software.}
Document assembly uses existing local software and saved results, without
package installation, model fitting, data acquisition, simulation reruns or
parameter searches. The separately executed studies record actual worker time,
resident memory and observed threads, distinct from requested budgets. Tests
use isolated tracked-input copies so synthetic fixtures cannot alter the
scientific archives.
